verdict.rationale: Cekura ships an official MCP server, Skills plugin, CLI, SDK and OpenAPI spec. Its docs say these let an AI assistant 'design, run, and improve voice-agent evaluations' and let users 'manage agents, scenarios, runs, and call data from your terminal.' That covers an agent creating test scenarios (evaluators), triggering runs programmatically and handling run data. missing for 10: an explicit dataset object (scenarios/evaluators stand in for datasets), documented programmatic retrieval of run results (result comparison is shown on the UI Results page), and any hands-on or independent corroboration of the end-to-end agent workflow.
